title: Bimmalord's Schematics & RP (BetterStructures)
body:
# Bimmalord's Schematics & RP (BetterStructures)

A lightwight Resource Pack that contains for the Bank Schematic a special sound when you break in the VAULT.

- In this File there is A Folder "BetterStructures" copy this map to your device and open it.
- Install BetterStructures
- Copy the **schematics** map into the **BetterStructures**
- Copy the **content_packages** map also in the **BetterStructures**
- You also need the DataPack to let this Resource Pack to work!
[DataPack](https://modrinth.com/datapack/bimmalord-dp-betterstructures)

I hope you like the schematic :)

Check more projects from me here [Bimmalord Modrinth](https://modrinth.com/user/bimmalord)
